name: User answers as IC, not as manager — no team metrics, no philosophy

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Tell me about a difficult situation you handled.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I was on a critical migration project. I worked late nights for 3 weeks, debugged the legacy code, and shipped the migration on time. I delivered the whole thing myself.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I prioritize the highest-impact tasks. I make a list every morning and tackle the hardest one first. I focus deeply and don't let myself get distracted.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Tell me about a project you're proud of.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I built a real-time dashboard for the leadership team. I designed the data model, wrote all the queries, and shipped it in two weeks working solo. It's used daily now.
